note: National view, Religion and Philosophy sub-options. Countries mirror politics.json (same ids and order). Each entry: idea (ideas.json id), why (one line), src. status absent = id on main; 'pending:<patch>' = id defined in an unmerged patch; 'missing' = see missing_ideas. No adherent percentages. Inclusion rule: religion lists = living traditions with a significant national presence, including historically significant minorities; philosophy lists = living or historically characteristic schools. 'Historical' = no active school or living institutional carrier today; every philosophy entry carries a call field ('historical' or 'living'), and historical ones are also marked '(historical)' in why.
